title: Swords into Plowshares
aka: war and peace in the last days
lead: The prophets' saying that weapons will be hammered into farm tools when the nations come to Zion (Isaiah 2:4; Micah 4:3), and Joel's reversal of it as a call to war (Joel 3:10).

sections.b: Isaiah 2:4 and Micah 4:3 picture the nations streaming to Zion to be taught, and ending war: they pound their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning knives. Joel 3:10 reverses the saying: "Pound your plowshares into swords and your pruning knives into spears." In Joel the nations are being summoned to the judgment in the Valley of Jehoshaphat. Which text is the older, and whether the saying was an old proverb, is disputed.
